hypotheses.justification: Pass to L = AlgebraicClosure K. Since K is a ℚ-algebra and p is prime, L has a primitive p-th root, by AlgebraicClosure.hasEnoughRootsOfUnity and HasEnoughRootsOfUnity.exists_isPrimitiveRoot; it is a unit. Apply the preceding roots_prime_at_slot and roots_prime_at_slot_nodup over L with N := p and divisibility dvd_rfl. The injective coefficient map F : LaurentSeries K →+* LaurentSeries L carries the polynomial in the conclusion to this polynomial over L: use coeffMap_qExpand, and check compatibility with qTwist and coeffEmb coefficientwise from their definitions. Descend nodup using Polynomial.map_roots_le_of_injective, Multiset.nodup_of_le, and Multiset.Nodup.of_map. This does not use hζ, N, or ζ, and works even when the original polynomial has no roots in K.

The conclusion is independent of N. Use the algebraic-closure argument described for hζ: choose a primitive p-th root there and apply the two preceding lemmas with N := p and dvd_rfl, then descend along the injective coefficient map using Polynomial.map_roots_le_of_injective and the multiset nodup lemmas. No divisibility assumption on the original N is needed, including when N = 1.

Neither IsPrimitiveRoot (ζ : K) N nor p ∣ N requires this instance to elaborate. Prove the conclusion after extending coefficients to AlgebraicClosure K, choosing a primitive p-th root and using the preceding two lemmas with N := p; descend nodup via Polynomial.map_roots_le_of_injective, Multiset.nodup_of_le, and Multiset.Nodup.of_map. Thus the proof is independent of the original N, including N = 0. This hypothesis, hζ, and hpN can all be omitted together.
